notes: US store (Ship to United States, USD). Tagline: 'Rooted in Heritage. Inspired by the Land. Reimagined for Today.' Free ground shipping on orders over $100 (https://www.barbour.com/us).

Bedale Waxed Jacket: $425, not marked down, 'mediumweight 6oz waxed cotton', sizes 30–52 even, Regular fit, 'Sponge clean only' (https://www.barbour.com/us/bedale%C2%AE-waxed-jacket-MWX0018BE51.html).
Returns: within 30 days of delivery, unworn with tags; one free return label; online orders can't be returned to stores; express shipping $20 (https://www.barbour.com/us/returns-refunds.html).

Wikipedia: founded 1894 in South Shields by John Barbour; HQ Simonside, South Shields; privately held, family-led; known for waxed cotton jackets incl. the Beaufort (1983) (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J._Barbour_and_Sons).

Men's shirts (US store, USD): fits named Tailored, Regular, Authentic-Fit and Relaxed; many tartan and check shirts (Dunoon, Bourne, Harleton, Hogside) (https://www.barbour.com/us/mens/mens-clothing/mens-shirts?sz=200).
